# Thrivefold: Mindful Health, On-Device Pose Tracking and Vitality Companion

> Production Site: https://thrivefold.devamit.co.in
> AnvayKosh Ecosystem Application: com.amit.thrivefold
> Systems Architect: Amit Chakraborty (https://amitchakraborty.dev)

## Technical Architecture & Core Capabilities
- Real-time camera pose guidance tracking 33 skeletal landmarks via MediaPipe.
- Android Health Connect integration running strictly on-device.
- Encrypted local SQLite databases with zero remote cloud persistence.
- All sensitive data processed 100% locally on user hardware.
- Cryptographic isolation backed by device Keystore AES-256 GCM encryption.
- Zero commercial data brokers, zero third-party telemetry SDKs, and zero advertisement networks.
